title: Track guide Oran Park - South Ray FF1600 Fixed iRacing

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: Brake hard two car lengths before the wall turns green.
corners.line: Turn in at the green wall, apex at the curb, exit on the left.
corners.exit: Go on throttle after passing the middle of the track.
corners.mistakes: Passing the middle of the track too early on exit.

corners.label: T2
corners.braking: Lift when getting to the curb on the left.
corners.line: Take as much curb as possible, exit full throttle.
corners.mistakes: Going too fast on the exit.

corners.label: T4
corners.braking: Brake to 40% at the curb on the right.
corners.line: Turn in, take only the colored curb on the left.
corners.exit: Full throttle after getting to the curb.

corners.label: T5
corners.braking: Brake just before the bottom of the hill.
corners.exit: Go full throttle after the rubbered-in part of the curb.
corners.mistakes: Carry too much speed and hit the wall.

corners.label: T6
corners.line: Take all of the curb and the white stuff.

corners.label: T7
corners.braking: Brake just before the bottom of the hill.
corners.line: Late apex just after the rubbered-in part of the curb.
corners.exit: Ease the car out towards the wall.
corners.mistakes: Carry too much speed and hit the wall.

general_tips: Take both curbs for turn five and six to gain time.
